candidate_reports.remark: An oak tree was uprooted and fell on a house. The roof sustained structural damage.
Multiple trees blown down along Arkansas 14.
Corrects previous tstm wnd dmg report from 1 ESE Rosie. Multiple trees blown down along Arkansas 14 and the updated location is evident via power outage map.
Personal weather station near Greenbrier measured 53 mph wind gust.
Multiple trees down across Russellville in addition to London and north of London.
ASOS station KLIT Little Rock Adams Field.
Numerous trees down in the area with widespread power outages. Winds estimated to be in excess of 70 mph and possibly higher to the east.
Powerlines down 2.2 miles west Wrightsville.
A few trees were knocked down onto powerlines.
Tree reported down on Highway 270 near the community of Eagleton.
A tree was reported down near this location onto East 1st Street in Waldron.
High water reported across several roads and a couple parking lots in Queen Wilhelmina State Park.
Water standing on the road at several locations along Highway 71 in Hatfield.
Water over the road along several locations where ditches are out of their banks and small creeks/drainage overflowing in and around the town of Cove.
Water was reported over several low water crossings along Highway 71 between Waldron and Y-City.
Water reported over several low water crossings along US Highway 270 in eastern Scott County.
Trained storm spotter reported brief rain wrapped tornado.
Broadcast media shared picture of possible landspout. Time estimated from radar.
Large limb blown down onto the roof of a home.
Quarter-sized hail reported at Izard County Sheriff Dept.
Tree limbs blown down.
Public shared picture of damage to State HWY 125. Time estimated from radar.
A 47 mph wind gust measured at Mena Intermountain Municipal Airport.
Polk County OEM reports scattered trees down throughout the county. Not necessarily concentrated in any one area_ but throughout the county as a result of wind from storms that moved through early th
Nearly the entire town of Delight is out of power due to powerlines and trees damaged in the area.
A tree was blown onto a home near the community of Hopper in southern Montgomery County.
Multiple trees were reportedly blown down all over Montgomery County_ from north to south. This particular point is simply meant to represent the northern half of Montgomery County_ not to specify da
Multiple trees were reported down in the vicinity of Antoine leading to widespread power outages.
Tree down on Highway 7 north of the center of Hot Springs.
A measured wind gust of 56 mph at KHOT ASOS (Not Springs Airport).
Trees down at the intersection of Hwy 359 and Hwy 315. Time estimated from radar.
Trees down across roadways and a tree on a home.
A tree down on a house near this location in Lamar.
A report of a tree down on a house in the community of Haskell near this location.
Reports of multiple power lines down in Russellville.
Water beginning to cover the roads and a few parking lots in portions of the town of Diaz at this location.
Multiple power outages reported in the vicinity of Tyndall Park area of Benton.
Reports of a tree blown down on a house near the 1900 block of Highway 113_ west of Morrilton. There were also other trees down in the area.
A measured gust of 47 mph was recorded at the Little Rock National Airport/Adams Field ASOS.
A tree blown down blocking southbound lanes of I-530 near White Hall.
A power line was blown down and caught fire along West 24th Ave in Pine Bluff.
A tree was blown down at the intersection of Highway 79 and Island Harbor Marina Road in White Hall.
Over 5 inches of rain was measured in Sidney_ since midnight local time.
Several large trees were blown down in this area.
Corrects previous flash flood report from Amagon. Some county roads around Amagon were shut down due to flash flooding.
Some county roads around Beedeville were shut down due to flash flooding.
Some county roads around Grubbs were shut down due to flash flooding.
Numerous low water crossings flooded across northern Faulkner County and southern Van Buren County. COOP observer at Damascus reported storm total rainfall of 4.14 inches as of 9:45 AM CT.
Low water bridge flooded along Newport Road.
Some county roads around Amagon were shut down due to flash flooding.
High water is occurring across a portion of Hwy 84 with both lanes of travel closed.
Portions of Dallas County Rd 206 and other nearby locations flooded and impassable due to high water throughout the area.
A few roads flooded in this area.
Water is covering portions of Hwy 128.
Tree damage observed around Greers Ferry by a USACE employee_ relayed via COOP observer. **Delayed Report**.
